python3 << 'EOF'
import re

# Test the regex
with open("/app/regex.txt") as f:
    pattern = f.read().strip()

test_cases = [
    # Line with IPv4 and one date
    "2024-01-15 192.168.1.1 some log",
    # Line with IPv4 and multiple dates (should match last)
    "2024-01-15 192.168.1.1 2024-02-28 2024-03-10",
    # Line without IPv4 (should not match)
    "2024-01-15 user 1134-12-1234",
    # Line with IPv4 but invalid date format
    "2024-13-01 192.168.1.1",
    # Edge case: Feb 29
    "2024-02-29 192.168.1.1",
    # Edge case: Feb 30 (invalid)
    "2024-02-30 192.168.1.1",
    # IPv4 at end
    "2024-01-15 some text 192.168.1.1",
    # Multiple dates, IPv4 in middle
    "2024-01-01 2024-06-15 192.168.1.1 2024-12-31",
]

for test in test_cases:
    matches = re.findall(pattern, test, re.MULTILINE)
    print(f"Input: {test!r}")
    print(f"Matches: {matches}")
    print()
EOF
